items.html: All Eser Sefirot of Beria were in the place which is now ZA de Atzilut in all its Eser Sefirot and his Nukva de Atzilut was then in the current place of Abba ve Ima de Atzilut. The Olamot continue similarly from Abba ve Ima de Atzilut upward to the highest degree, to Ein Sof, higher than their current degree and we need not elaborate here.
